summary: Enhance your skills with our Advanced Spatial Analysis with QGIS Training Course. Learn to analyze complex spatial data effectively and elevate your projects.
lede: QGIS spatial analysis helps geospatial professionals automate complex workflows beyond basic mapping. The course covers PostGIS queries, raster analysis and map algebra, multi-criteria evaluation, and reproducible processing models built with the QGIS Graphical Modeler. These capabilities apply to tasks such as assessing site suitability, analyzing terrain, and streamlining geoprocessing.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for geospatial professionals who need to move beyond basic cartography and implement rigorous, automated spatial analytics.
modules: Advanced Raster Analysis and Map Algebra
Workflow Automation with the Graphical Modeler
Advanced Cartography and Web Map Publishing
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of fundamental GIS concepts and prior experience using QGIS or ArcGIS® for standard mapping tasks. No prior programming or SQL experience is required, though familiarity with database concepts is advantageous. Participants must bring a laptop with QGIS 3.x (latest stable release) installed and administrative rights to configure database connections.
